subject: Infrastructure Neglect and Evans Street Roadway Repairs
overview: The City Council addressed widespread resident frustration regarding delayed roadway repairs, particularly on Evans Street, while discussing proposals for shade tree protection and a shopping cart retrieval ordinance. Members also examined zoning transparency issues related to a new gas station canopy on Winthrop Street.

items.title: Memorial to Firefighter Timothy Brennan
items.summary: The council dedicated the meeting and held a moment of silence in memory of Firefighter Timothy Brennan on the second anniversary of his passing.

items.title: Brookside Parkway Stop Sign
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting an update from the Department of Public Works regarding a downed stop sign being replaced with a cone.

items.title: Sign Reversal Petition: 5 High Street
items.summary: Approved a subcommittee report and granted a sign denial reversal for Wayside Youth and Family with conditions regarding signage color and placement.

items.title: Evans Street Water and Pipe Repairs
items.summary: Residents and councilors criticized the administration for multi-year delays on promised repairs to Evans Street, resulting in a formal request for the city engineer to provide a project timeline and budget confirmation by the next meeting.

items.title: Shopping Cart Ordinance Proposal
items.summary: Referred a proposal to the Public Works Committee that would require businesses to implement electronic locking mechanisms or retrieval plans for abandoned shopping carts.

items.title: Tree Protection and Urban Forestry Fund
items.summary: Referred a proposal to the Public Works Committee and the Mayor to increase the tree warden's authority over utility work and establish a revolving fund for shade tree preservation.

items.title: Sunken Manhole and Sewer Grate Repairs
items.summary: Approved resolutions to repair hazardous sunken manholes and sewer grates on Rita Drive and Bell Avenue.

items.title: Utility Patching on Clifton Road
items.summary: Requested that the city engineer provide a report on sinking utility patches on Clifton Road and a city-wide update on all public utility roadway work since 2014.

items.title: Winthrop Street Gas Station Canopy and Zoning Transparency
items.summary: Discussed neighborhood complaints regarding a large new canopy on Winthrop Street and called for the administration to make all zoning and building plans accessible to the public online.

items.title: Blasting Notifications for Winthrop Street Construction
items.summary: Requested that the Fire Chief ensure residents and schools receive at least 48 hours notice before scheduled blasting at a new construction site.

items.title: Ceremonial Recognitions and Condolences
items.summary: Congratulated Michael and Sheila McGlynn on their 40th anniversary and offered condolences to the family of Scoutmaster Dennis Akdikens.

items.title: Routine Roadway and Infrastructure Maintenance
items.summary: Approved various resolutions to fill potholes on Parris and Commercial Streets, repave a section of 4th Street, replace a utility-damaged sidewalk on Stearns Avenue, and clear catch basin debris at 2nd and Middlesex Avenue.

items.title: Council Litigation Funding
items.summary: Discussed transferring $4,300 in available expense funds for legal fees but deferred the decision to the upcoming budget hearings to avoid exhausting office supply accounts.
